description: The change-set arrives grouped and ordered for reading without requiring a model
naive_change: Structural pipeline produces flow-groups with a read order plus module, file, and entity graph views
outcomes: reviewer sees each flow-group read order before opening a hunk

description: The tests, comments, imports, and callers needed to judge an entity sit beside it or one click away, whatever the project test layout
naive_change: Link tests to entities by graph edges and naming conventions and render a context strip per entity
outcomes: reviewer opens the tests for an entity within one click

description: Test, invariant, fixture, and profiling evidence is shown visually wherever it exists, with a path to the full report
naive_change: Built-in bar, plot, radar, and flame charts fed by providers; profile ingest for spark (lucko), folded-stack flamegraph, speedscope, Chrome trace, pprof, and criterion
outcomes: reviewer sees invariant evidence for a tested entity

description: New contextual views can be added for an anchor while a review is underway
naive_change: Sandboxed TypeScript visualizers in a Web Worker, registered by an agent or reviewer, inspired by Glamorous Toolkit moldable development
outcomes: agent registers a visualizer for an anchor without rebuilding diffcore

description: Each claim appears at the code it is about rather than in a separate list
naive_change: Literate, org-mode-style inline claim blocks rendered at their anchor in both diff and graph views
outcomes: reviewer reads each claim beside its anchor

description: Where a claim and the evidence disagree, the disagreement is surfaced
naive_change: Compare claim scope against impact and graph evidence and flag mismatches on the anchor
outcomes: reviewer sees each conflict between a claim and evidence

description: Every visualizer shows where its data came from and who authored it
naive_change: Visualizers declare a data source; agent-authored visualizers carry a badge that cannot be hidden
outcomes: reviewer sees the evidence source behind each visualizer

description: Entity-level evidence, including edges into unchanged code, holds across the languages reviewers work in
naive_change: sem-core entity graph behind one adapter; retire the legacy parser and the query engine
outcomes: diffcore resolves entity edges into unchanged code

description: Reviewing a project leaves no trace in it
naive_change: All state in a user-level store; hidden refs only when pinning commits
outcomes: diffcore reviews its own project without writing into the project

description: Many review-sessions across projects, agent threads, and worktrees run at once and each keeps its own state through restarts
naive_change: User-level SQLite store of projects, threads, worktrees, and review-sessions modelled on T3 Code

description: Reviewer feedback reaches the agent, and the agent replies, pushback, and questions return to the reviewer in the same place

description: From its own thread an agent can show the reviewer where something is, answering questions like where are you doing X
naive_change: MCP point_at tool creates a claim on the anchor and focuses open diffcore views on it
outcomes: agent points the reviewer to an anchor from its own thread

description: Reviewers and agents get the same analysis whichever surface they use
naive_change: One core analyze function behind CLI, HTTP, and MCP
outcomes: agent obtains the same evidence the reviewer sees

description: Each change-set is shown against the boundaries its project declares
naive_change: Boundary providers overlay holds, crosses, and breaks on the graph and flow-groups
